svg.title: Kustamie architecture overview
svg.desc: Users reach Kustamie on two paths. Event info goes through Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda functions in a VPC, which call application services on Amazon ECS backed by Amazon ElastiCache and Amazon RDS (Aurora Serverless v2). Real-time data uses Amazon IVS Chat over WebSocket and video streams through Amazon IVS; ECS pushes interactive data into IVS Chat.
